method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: One giant YES/NO word
features.detail: the whole page is one word answering the question
features.verse_evidence: functions/is-it/[what].js page(): <h1 id="w"> sized to the screen

features.name: Answer in the visitor's language
features.detail: the word is localised (the site guesses from the IP / geolocation)
features.verse_evidence: skills/is-it.js WORDS: 60 languages from the browser's Accept-Language / navigator.languages

features.name: Works with JavaScript off
features.detail: the answer is in the served HTML
features.verse_evidence: functions/is-it/[what].js renders the page on the server

features.name: Live crowd of visitors' flags
features.detail: in Christmas week every visitor is a moving flag of their country, live over websockets
features.verse_evidence: skills/is-it.js "Everyone here" switch, public-is-it relay room, joins by itself 24-26 December

features.name: Turn your own flag
features.detail: scroll wheel / arrow keys turn your flag 15 degrees, middle click straightens it; others see it

features.name: Country legend on hover
features.detail: hovering a flag names its country

features.name: Flag set covering territories
features.detail: flags for sovereign nations plus gathered territory flags (isitchristmas/flags repo)
features.verse_evidence: skills/is-it.js flagOf() draws emoji regional-indicator flags only; no custom territory flags

features.name: RSS feed
features.detail: a feed that says NO every day and YES on Christmas

features.name: JSON / IFTTT answer service
features.detail: an IFTTT service and API returning YES or NO
features.verse_evidence: /is-it/<day>.json exists (answerJson); no IFTTT or other automation-platform listing

features.name: Official iPhone and Android apps
features.detail: open-sourced mobile apps that answer the question
features.verse_evidence: no native app; the page installs offline via sw.js only

features.name: Open-source code and published visit data
features.detail: site, apps, flags and connection counts published on GitHub
features.verse_evidence: this repository is public; no published per-country visit data

features.name: Festive effects on the day
features.detail: Christmas decorations / snow on the day
features.verse_evidence: skills/is-it.js snowfall and the midnight wave 24-26 December

features.name: Console easter eggs
features.detail: messages for the curious in the browser console

verse_extra: Any day, not only Christmas: Halloween, Easter, Thanksgiving, Fridays, leap years and more (skills/is-it.js DAYS)
Live countdown to the next one, flipping by itself at your midnight
The midnight wave: Christmas followed round 36 places from Kiritimati to Pago Pago
Language asked for in words ("is it christmas in french")
Language from the device, never guessed from the network
RSS that stays silent until the day (?only=yes)
Share button using the phone share sheet
Ripple on tap and a flag stamp on long press, shared with the crowd
gaps: Open-source code and published visit data
